title: Runtime Composition X0 Governed Execution Evidence Baseline

phases.objective: Instrument representative existing governed execution entry points with passive no-secret X0 telemetry, publish reproducible matched-fixture evidence, and make the bounded process-memory emitter reachable in Staging without changing execution decisions or enabling Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed runtime maintainer and Staging certification operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the registered X0 telemetry, matched-fixture and runtime-composition validators on the exact candidate and then require the external live-Staging gate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GPT Tool, System Tool, Connector Plan, Agent Loop and existing Sequential Plan boundaries produce or support bounded no-secret evidence with identical functional outcomes; Staging can activate the process-memory sink; Production remains disabled by default; X1 remains blocked until exact-head CI and live-Staging certification pass.
steps: Resolve the candidate from exact current main and keep base-main provenance identical in the X0 manifest and matched fixture artifact.
Instrument GPT/System transport boundaries with bounded correlation, round-trip and response-size evidence while leaving missing internal/provider counters unobserved.
Instrument Connector Plan context/policy/provider interval/ledger boundaries and count Make MCP provider calls only at the proven network dispatch frontier.
Instrument Agent Loop model and tool calls by wrapping existing dependencies while preserving return values and exception behavior.
Regenerate F01/F03/F04/F05/F06 deterministic matched fixtures and require legacy/instrumented result-hash and safety-vector parity.
Resolve a process-local emitter only when explicitly injected or GOVERNED_EXECUTION_BASELINE_ENABLED=true; keep the default disabled.
Enable the bounded 500-sample process-memory sink in Staging Compose only; do not enable it in the base Production-capable Compose contract.
Refresh the portable Staging generated manifest through its canonical generator after the Compose input changes.
Register the X0 E2E declaration in both Constitution.control_plane_paths and derived-state convergence automation_control_paths.
Run exact-head repository CI and environment-impact closure; require live-Staging certification externally and prohibit source-tree self-attestation.
Do not begin X1 until Gate X0 external certification is complete.
assertions: X0 adds no provider call, database write, migration, external send, permission grant, retry, route, OpenAPI operation, runtime cutover, or Production mutation.
Instrumentation disabled by configuration remains behavior-neutral and optional trace creation returns no runtime handle.
Instrumentation/emitter failure cannot fail the measured operation.
Raw arguments, prompts, headers, JWTs, credentials, provider payloads, result bodies and arbitrary error strings are excluded from X0 snapshots.
Unobserved counters are never interpreted as observed zeroes.
A provider-dispatch duration does not prove a provider call; provider_calls increments only at an explicitly observed provider boundary.
Matched F01/F03/F04/F05/F06 fixtures use deterministic provider simulators and are not represented as live provider certification.
The X0 process sink is bounded process-lifetime memory, is non-authoritative, and performs no SQL persistence or external send.
Staging activation is explicit while the base Production-capable Compose file does not enable X0.
The X0 E2E declaration is registered in both repository-governance control-plane registries; this registration does not create new execution authority.
The candidate tree records exact-head and live-Staging certification as external requirements only.
X010 and all X1 implementation remain unstarted until Gate X0 closes.
